headline: Ramayana Day 18: ₹35.60 Cr India nett
lede: Ramayana's Day 18 collection so far, on Monday, 23 November 2026, is ₹35.60 Cr India nett and ₹42.50 Cr India gross, +28.8% from Day 17's ₹27.65 Cr. That is across 16,277 shows at 37.9% occupancy. Updated 05:31 pm IST, and still a live estimate rather than the final drop.
body:
Through Day 18 the desk has Ramayana at ₹978.4 Cr India nett, ₹1,126.5 Cr India gross, ₹567.0 Cr overseas and ₹1,693.5 Cr worldwide. Adding the day-wise nett rows gives ₹942.75 Cr, which is a different series from that lifetime nett, so the two are not combined. Behind it on the daily chart, O.M Operation Mole at ₹15.90 Cr and Aakasamlo Oka Tara at ₹5.75 Cr. This day's overseas figure is not in, so it is not used to move the worldwide total.

Trade coverage is still led by Ramayana. The desk figure remains ₹978.4 Cr India nett and ₹1,693.5 Cr worldwide. No producer-certified total is included.
